items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: everything that the Platters made with Tony Williams, I was playing drums on.

ctx.x: became a big hit, that's when he did the album that they used the all white band on, and I met him a couple of days afterwards, and said to him, I said, "Look, Bobby, man, why didn't you call me to do your date?" and he said to me, "Well, you know, when you move up in the world, you change company", and that was his answer to me for not using me on this date.

Then, I recorded, like all of the Platters records. I made "The Great Pretender", "Stardust", oh, let's see, "The Great Pretender", "Stardust", "Harbor Lights" -- in fact, everything that the Platters made with Tony Williams, I was playing drums on.
